topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: Rain’s pouring down, streets are rivers.期末考试周 Got a call from my old partner in crime, told me my best friend's hauling up stakes, heading clear across the country. God, people can be so damn unpredictable. One minute you're throwing back shots, laughing over the same old stories, next thing you know they're packing up, leaving you to toast to their memory. You try to keep it cool, act like it's no big deal, but as the city keeps on humming around you and the rain's just a ceaseless background noise, you can't help but feel like the world's getting a little too empty, a little too fast. You reach for the bottle, figure maybe a drink'll slow the world down, just a touch.
